description: This file defines the AliasPrefixList class, which manages caching and retrieval of valid alias prefixes for paths in Drupal, including cache loading, cache miss resolution, and cache clearing.

classes.name: AliasPrefixList
classes.description: Manages caching of valid alias prefixes for paths, including loading, cache miss resolution, and cache clearing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AliasPrefixList with cache ID, cache backend, lock backend, state, and alias repository.

methods.name: lazyLoadCache
methods.description: Loads cache data lazily, initializing prefix list from 'router.path_roots' state if storage is empty.

methods.name: loadMenuPathRoots
methods.description: Prepopulates cache with path roots from the state 'router.path_roots'.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves cache status for a given path, returning TRUE if valid, or resolving cache miss if not present.

methods.name: resolveCacheMiss
methods.description: Checks if a path has a matching alias and updates cache accordingly.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the cache and reloads menu path roots.
